children: Cyber Enviro-Tech disclosed two amendments to its equity purchase agreement with Monroe Street Capital Partners, which provides for up to $30 million in stock sales during a commitment period. An August amendment reduced the minimum put amount to facilitate notices, while an October amendment changed the pricing benchmarks to end-of-day volume-weighted average prices; the 85% pricing factor and other material terms remain unchanged.
